description: A close, half-length view of a dark warrior seen from slightly below and to one side, turned toward the left. A pale, crested metal helm covers the head, and from the shadow beneath it glints a single cold teal eye. The body is clad in grey scale or chain mail over dark leather, with rows of brown studded plates across the chest. A gauntleted fist at the lower left grips a long, gleaming silver sword that slants up across the whole picture to the top right corner. Behind the figure the background is black, licked by ragged red and yellow flames. The mood is menacing and hot, the armor catching harsh firelight. Frame 1: the sword rises at a steep diagonal. Frame 2: the blade tilts a little steeper and the flames shift. Frame 3: the sword returns to its first angle. Frame 4: the blade dips lower and flatter as the fire flickers again. Every frame is brief, so the loop reads as a quick, trembling sway of the raised blade against flickering flames.
title: Dark knight with longsword before flames
